name: Exp_Chaikin_Volatility_Stochastic
summary: This EA trades based on crossover signals from the Chaikin Volatility Stochastic custom indicator. It opens buy positions when the oscillator lines cross downward and sell positions when they cross upward, with configurable money management and position closing logic. The strategy operates on a multi-timeframe basis using a selectable higher timeframe for signal generation while executing on the current chart timeframe.
summary_zh: 该EA基于Chaikin波动率随机指标的自定义交叉信号进行交易。当振荡器线条向下交叉时开多仓，向上交叉时开空仓，配有可配置的资金管理和仓位关闭逻辑。策略使用可选的更高时间框架生成信号，同时在当前图表时间框架上执行交易。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略基于Chaikin波动率随机指标的两条线交叉信号。入场条件为：当Osc1从上方穿越Osc2（向下交叉）时产生买入信号，当Osc1从下方穿越Osc2（向上交叉）时产生卖出信号，信号基于SignalBar指定的K线进行判断。出场条件包括止损和止盈的硬性设置（StopLoss_=1000, TakeProfit_=2000点），以及反向交叉信号触发的平仓逻辑。仓位管理采用可配置的资金管理比例（MM=0.1），支持固定手数和保证金比例两种模式。EA使用了多种平滑算法（SMA、EMA、JJMA、JurX等）对指标进行平滑处理，提高了信号的稳定性。策略仅在新的K线形成时重新计算信号，避免了逐tick的频繁交易，但缺乏对市场波动性和点差的过滤机制。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is based on crossover signals between two lines of the Chaikin Volatility Stochastic custom indicator. Entry conditions are: a buy signal is generated when Osc1 crosses below Osc2 (downward crossover), and a sell signal is generated when Osc1 crosses above Osc2 (upward crossover), with signals evaluated on the bar specified by SignalBar. Exit conditions include hard stop loss and take profit settings (StopLoss_=1000, TakeProfit_=2000 points), as well as position closing logic triggered by reverse crossover signals. Position sizing uses a configurable money management ratio (MM=0.1), supporting both fixed lot and margin percentage modes. The EA employs multiple smoothing algorithms (SMA, EMA, JJMA, JurX, etc.) for indicator smoothing, which enhances signal stability. The strategy only recalculates signals on new bar formation, avoiding excessive tick-by-tick trading, but lacks filtering mechanisms for market volatility and spread.

parameters.name: MM
parameters.description: 资金管理比例，控制仓位大小

parameters.name: MMMode
parameters.description: 仓位计算模式（固定手数或保证金比例）
parameters.description_en: Margin mode: free margin/balance/net margin/net balance/fixed lot

parameters.name: BuyPosClose
parameters.description: 是否允许反向信号平多仓
parameters.description_en: Allow buy-side close (close sell on opposite signal)

parameters.name: SellPosClose
parameters.description: 是否允许反向信号平空仓
parameters.description_en: Allow sell-side close (close buy on opposite signal)

parameters.name: SignalBar
parameters.description: 用于检测信号的K线索引

parameters.name: WMALength
parameters.description: 加权移动平均周期长度

pros: 使用Chaikin波动率结合随机指标，融合了波动率和动量分析，策略逻辑具有一定深度
支持多种平滑算法选择（10种），灵活性强，可针对不同市场优化
新K线检测机制避免了逐tick交易，减少交易频率和滑点影响
止损止盈设置完整，且反向信号也可触发平仓，双重保护机制
买入和卖出的开仓与平仓均可独立开关控制，灵活性高
pros_en: Combines Chaikin volatility with stochastic logic, integrating both volatility and momentum analysis for deeper strategy insight
Supports 10 smoothing algorithm options, providing high flexibility for optimization across different market conditions
New bar detection mechanism avoids tick-by-tick trading, reducing trade frequency and slippage impact
Complete stop loss and take profit settings with reverse signal closing providing dual protection
Buy and sell open/close operations can be independently toggled, offering high configuration flexibility
cons: 缺乏点差过滤机制，在高点差环境下可能产生不利成交
没有持仓数量检查，可能在已有同向仓位时重复开仓
指标依赖自定义外部指标Chaikin_Volatility_Stochastic，若该指标缺失则EA无法运行
止损1000点和止盈2000点设置过大，可能不适用于所有品种和时间框架
没有加仓或减仓逻辑，仓位管理方式单一
cons_en: Lacks spread filtering, which may result in unfavorable fills in high-spread environments
No position count check, potentially opening duplicate positions in the same direction
Depends on the custom external indicator Chaikin_Volatility_Stochastic; if missing, the EA cannot run
Stop loss of 1000 points and take profit of 2000 points are excessively large and may not suit all instruments and timeframes
No position scaling logic (add/reduce), resulting in a single-dimensional position management approach
improvements: 增加点差过滤和波动率过滤机制，避免在不利市场条件下开仓
增加持仓检查和最大持仓限制，防止重复开仓导致过度暴露风险
增加移动止损（Trailing Stop）功能，在趋势行情中锁定浮动利润
improvements_en: Add spread filter and volatility filter mechanisms to avoid opening positions under unfavorable market conditions
Add position checking and maximum position limits to prevent duplicate entries leading to excessive risk exposure
Add trailing stop functionality to lock in floating profits during trending markets

risk_points: 缺乏点差过滤，在流动性差的市场可能遭受较大滑点损失
无持仓数量检查，可能在同方向重复开仓增加风险暴露
依赖外部自定义指标，存在运行时依赖性风险
固定止损止盈值未根据品种波动率动态调整
risk_points_en: No spread filter may cause significant slippage losses in low-liquidity markets
No position count check may lead to duplicate same-direction entries increasing risk exposure
Dependency on external custom indicator introduces runtime dependency risk
Fixed stop loss/take profit values are not dynamically adjusted based on instrument volatility
